root = Stack([WeightsControl, ScoresTable, NormalizedWeightsText, RankedResultsText])

WeightsControl = Control("Adjust Criteria Weights",0,100,[40,25,35],$weights)
weights = integer

NormalizedWeightsText = Text("Normalized Weights: " + (sumWeights == 0 ? "N/A" : "Native Experience: " + nativeNorm + ", Lightweight Runtime: " + lightweightNorm + ", Delivery Efficiency: " + deliveryNorm))

ScoresTable = Table([
  {label:"Native Hybrid", native:9, lightweight:8, delivery:7},
  {label:"Tauri", native:7, lightweight:8, delivery:8},
  {label:"Electron", native:6, lightweight:4, delivery:10}
])

sumWeights = weights[0] + weights[1] + weights[2]
nativeNorm = sumWeights == 0 ? 0 : weights[0] * 1.0 / sumWeights
lightweightNorm = sumWeights == 0 ? 0 : weights[1] * 1.0 / sumWeights
deliveryNorm = sumWeights == 0 ? 0 : weights[2] * 1.0 / sumWeights

scoreNativeHybrid = 9 * nativeNorm + 8 * lightweightNorm + 7 * deliveryNorm
scoreTauri = 7 * nativeNorm + 8 * lightweightNorm + 8 * deliveryNorm
scoreElectron = 6 * nativeNorm + 4 * lightweightNorm + 10 * deliveryNorm

ranked = sumWeights == 0 ? [] : @Sort([
  {label:"Native Hybrid", score:scoreNativeHybrid},
  {label:"Tauri", score:scoreTauri},
  {label:"Electron", score:scoreElectron}
],"score","desc")

rankStrings = sumWeights == 0 ? "No ranking (all weights zero)" : "Ranking:\n1. " + ranked[0].label + " (" + ranked[0].score + ")\n2. " + ranked[1].label + " (" + ranked[1].score + ")\n3. " + ranked[2].label + " (" + ranked[2].score + ")"

RankedResultsText = Text(rankStrings)
